name: 71282 · Tallulah, LA
findings: ZIP 71282 (Tallulah) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 71282 (Tallulah) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 71282 (Tallulah) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 65% of the typical level).
